text: Gerwyn Price beat Gian van Veen 16-11 to win the Grand Slam of Darts for a fourth time, ending a four-year wait for a major.
Carlos Alcaraz beat Alexander Zverev 6-2 7-6 to win the ATP Finals for the first time, joining Agassi, Federer and Djokovic with a career Grand Slam and the title.
Kansas City Current beat Washington Spirit 2-1 to win their first NWSL title, Debinha scoring in stoppage time and the Spirit losing a third straight final.
Luke Littler and The King's Trust have launched an opportunity fund to help young people in the north west of England into work.
England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham, their biggest win over the All Blacks, and meet them again on 28 November in the Nations Championship finals weekend.
